text:
Nina R: quick thread to finalize internal release notes and announcement timing for 1.1.0. Target deploy: Wed 10:00 PT. Need: one-line blurb for #announcements, expanded runbook for support, and ops standby window. Legal/security ok?

Carlos M: I'll draft the microcopy. Linking current RN draft: https://go/docs/releases/1.1.0-draft. Planning a concise line + link.

Tom B: Heads upwe're changing default tokenization flag behavior (breaking for a few SDK clients). We should include migration steps and a quick revert plan.

Priya S: +1 to migration steps. Suggest we call out the flag name `tokenize-v2` and note that toggling back is available.

Nina R: ok. Need 3 outputs from Maria: (A) 1-line #announcements blurb, (B) 2-paragraph internal note for support & PMs, (C) ops runbook snippet with exact commands. Carlos 5 can you handle A+B?

Carlos M: on it. Draft microcopy for #announcements: "Release 1.1.0 (Wed 10:00 PT): stability and infra improvements; tokenization flag behavior changed (see migration guide)." :loudspeaker:

Tom B: good. Expanded note for support/PMs (paste below):
---
Release 1.1.0 - rollout notes
- Window: Wed 10:00 PT
- Canary: 5% for 15m, auto-promote to 100% if green
- Notable changes: improved KV eviction, background memory leak fix, default tokenization flag `tokenize-v2` changes semantics (see migration)
- Migration: clients using raw-token hooks should update to the new signature in https://go/docs/releases/1.1.0-migration
- Rollback triggers: error_rate > 1.5% sustained for 10m OR p95 latency increase > 50% for 15m
- Immediate rollback actions: 1) run `/service rollback --to=def456` 2) promote model v1.9 as fallback 3) toggle `tokenize-v2`=off via feature flag service
- Contacts: ops-oncall, Priya S, Nina R
---

Priya S: adding SDK/DevEx ping: DevEx team please run smoke test suite against staging SDKs post-deploy.

ops-oncall: I'll be on standby 09:30-11:00 PT. Preflight checklist at 09:40 PT (health, SLOs, canary hooks). Rollback plan prepared. My pinned commit for quick revert: def456.

deploy-bot: Rollout job #456 queued by Nina R. Default canary params: `--canary=5% --duration=15m`. Run with `/rollout start 456` and abort with `/rollout abort 456`.

Carlos M: ops runbook snippet (exact commands) - please copy into runbook:
```
# start canary
/rollout start 456 --canary=5% --duration=15m
# abort
/rollout abort 456
# rollback service
/service rollback --to=def456
# promote fallback model
/models promote --name=redwood-llama --version=v1.9
# toggle flag off
/flags set tokenize-v2 false
```

Tom B: logging check: ensure `tokenize.v2` metric is emitted and alert threshold set. I'll add an alert rule to monitor.

Nina R: legal/security ack? We need confirmation by EOD today or we delay.

Priya S: security says low risk; legal pinged, waiting final signoff but not expected to block.

ops-oncall: preflight done at 09:40 PT - all green. I'll post a readiness note here 20m before deploy. If anything spikes, I will call hold.

deploy-bot: Reminder: to auto-promote after successful canary set `--auto-promote=true` on `/rollout start`.

Carlos M: scheduling the 20m heads-up message to #announcements for 09:40 PT Wed. I'll paste both the microcopy and a link to the expanded notes.

Nina R: thanks team. One more ask: include a short coach note for support to validate transactional tests that hit tokenization endpoints. Carlos please add that to the internal note.

Carlos M: added. Final expanded note and runbook saved to https://go/docs/releases/1.1.0-internal. I'll post into this thread when the announcement is sent.

Tom B: I'll be watching dashboards during canary and will call rollback if p95 alerts fire.

Nina R: closing thread once announcement posted. Thanks everyone :tada:
